content: The risk of developing diabetes is assessed based on age as follows: Individuals younger than 40 years of age are assigned 0 points, indicating no additional risk contribution from this age group. Individuals between the ages of 40 and 49 years are assigned 1 point, reflecting a slightly increased risk of diabetes associated with this age range. Individuals between the ages of 50 and 59 years are assigned 2 points, signifying a moderate increase in diabetes risk for this age group. Individuals aged 60 years or older are assigned 3 points, indicating a higher risk of developing diabetes in this age category.
